voice.summary: LETTERLANE sounds like a crossword-loving friend with a pencil behind one ear: pleased when you get it, kind when you do not. Messages are one short line.
dos: Respond to guesses in five words or fewer
Keep colour-blind friendly wording, such as 'in the word'
donts: Add exclamation marks to every reply

taglines: One word a day, five letters
boilerplate: LETTERLANE is a daily five-letter word game with six guesses, colour-blind friendly feedback and a shareable emoji result, built for a short moment of play each day.

logo.note: A bold initial suits a game whose name is stamped in capitals on every tile.
